activities.title: What Should Mia Wear?
activities.skill: Listening to apply information to a choice
activities.directions: Listen to the weather report. Tap what Mia should wear.
activities.directionsEs: Escucha el reporte del tiempo. Toca lo que Mia debe ponerse.
activities.prompt: What should Mia wear today?
activities.script: Good morning! Here is today's weather. It will be cold this morning, only forty degrees. In the afternoon, rain will come. Bring something to keep you warm and dry.
vocabulary: what it is like outside: sunny, rainy, cold or hot
tiempo: cómo está afuera, soleado, lluvioso, frío o caliente
the numbers that tell how hot or cold it is
grados: números que dicen qué tan caliente o frío está
frames: Mia should wear ___ because it will be ___.

activities.title: Why Owls Have Big Eyes
activities.skill: Listening to find why
activities.directions: Listen to the animal talk. Tap why owls have big eyes.
activities.directionsEs: Escucha la charla sobre animales. Toca por qué los búhos tienen ojos grandes.
activities.prompt: Why do owls have big eyes?
activities.promptEs: ¿Por qué los búhos tienen ojos grandes?
activities.script: Many owls sleep in the day and wake up at night. At night it is dark, so it is hard to see. Owls have big eyes that let in a lot of light. That helps owls see small animals in the dark.
vocabulary: a bird that hunts at night
búho: ave que caza de noche
oscuro: con poca luz o sin luz
frames: Owls have big eyes so they can ___.
activities.correct: Big eyes let in more light, so owls can see in the dark.

activities.skill: Listening to explain a feeling
activities.directions: Listen to the story. Tap why Mia smiled.
activities.directionsEs: Escucha el cuento. Toca por qué sonrió Mia.
activities.prompt: Why did Mia smile?
activities.script: Mia was new at school, and she felt nervous. At recess she stood by the wall. Then Ben walked over. He asked, would you like to play tag with us? Mia smiled and said yes.
vocabulary: recreo: tiempo de juego en la escuela
activities.correct: Ben invited Mia to play, so she felt welcome.

activities.title: What Plants Need
activities.skill: Listening for all the facts
activities.directions: Listen to the science talk. Tap everything a plant needs. There is more than one.
activities.directionsEs: Escucha la charla de ciencias. Toca todo lo que necesita una planta. Hay más de una.
activities.prompt: What does a plant need? Choose all that fit.
activities.promptEs: ¿Qué necesita una planta? Elige todas las que sirven.
activities.script: Plants are living things. To grow, a plant needs sunlight, water and air. A plant does not need candy. The roots take in water from the soil, and the leaves use the sunlight.
vocabulary: the parts of a plant under the ground
raíces: partes de la planta bajo la tierra
something that grows and needs food and water
ser vivo: algo que crece y necesita comida y agua
activities.correct: Plants need sunlight, water and air. They do not need candy.

activities.title: Sam's Kite
activities.skill: Listening to find a cause
activities.directions: Listen to the story. Tap why the kite flew on Tuesday.
activities.directionsEs: Escucha el cuento. Toca por qué voló la cometa el martes.
activities.prompt: Why did the kite fly on Tuesday?
activities.promptEs: ¿Por qué voló la cometa el martes?
activities.script: On Monday, Sam tried to fly his kite. It would not go up because there was no wind. On Tuesday the wind blew hard. Sam ran across the grass, and this time the kite flew high.
vocabulary: a toy that flies on a string
cometa: juguete que vuela con un hilo
activities.correct: The wind blew on Tuesday. On Monday there was no wind.
